g.text: Eng. Automation & Computer Science, UTCN Cluj-Napoca — graduating 2026
I combine different perspectives and accumulated knowledge — branding, UI/UX, strategy and
technical skills — to constantly improve and help brands grow and expand in the market with
the help of well defined systems and processes. Skilled in a variety of technologies and PM
methodologies, including Spring Framework, Microservices, Database Design, Strategy
Development, Project Management and Business Process Mapping & Automation.
